code: library(costcomorbidity)  rxrisk_indicators <- identify_comorbidities(   people = example_people,   codes = example_codes,   index = "rxrisk" )  rxrisk_scores <- apply_cost_weights(   indicators = rxrisk_indicators,   index = "rxrisk",   keep_indicators = FALSE )  head(rxrisk_scores) #> # A tibble: 6 × 2 #>   id    costbased_rxrisk #>   <chr>            <dbl> #> 1 S0001            4.05  #> 2 S0002            0.259 #> 3 S0003            0     #> 4 S0004            0.756 #> 5 S0005            4.05  #> 6 S0006            0

code: apply_cost_weights(   indicators,   index = "charlson",   id = "id",   keep_indicators = TRUE )

title: Apply cost-based comorbidity weights — apply_cost_weights
text: indicators data frame containing one row per person one binary column category selected index. index Character string specifying comorbidity index. Must one `"charlson"`, `"elixhauser"`, `"rxrisk"`. id Character string giving person-identifier column `indicators`. keep_indicators Logical. `TRUE`, binary indicators retained. `FALSE`, identifier score returned.

title: Apply cost-based comorbidity weights — apply_cost_weights
text: data frame containing identifier, optionally binary   indicators, one `costbased_charlson`, `costbased_elixhauser`,   `costbased_rxrisk`.

title: Apply cost-based comorbidity weights — apply_cost_weights
text: binary indicator multiplied corresponding cost-based coefficient, weighted values summed person.

title: Apply cost-based comorbidity weights — apply_cost_weights
code: charlson_indicators <- identify_comorbidities(   people = example_people,   codes = example_codes,   index = "charlson" )  charlson_scores <- apply_cost_weights(   indicators = charlson_indicators,   index = "charlson",   keep_indicators = FALSE )  head(charlson_scores) #> # A tibble: 6 × 2 #>   id    costbased_charlson #>   <chr>              <dbl> #> 1 S0001               3.70 #> 2 S0002               0    #> 3 S0003               0    #> 4 S0004               1.44 #> 5 S0005               0    #> 6 S0006               0

title: Identify comorbidity categories from clinical codes — identify_comorbidities

title: Identify comorbidity categories from clinical codes — identify_comorbidities
code: identify_comorbidities(   people,   codes,   index = "charlson",   id = "id",   code = "code",   code_system = "code_system" )

title: Identify comorbidity categories from clinical codes — identify_comorbidities
text: people data frame containing one row per person. codes long-format data frame containing clinical codes. Multiple rows per person allowed. index Character string specifying comorbidity index. Must one `"charlson"`, `"elixhauser"`, `"rxrisk"`. id Character string giving person-identifier column `people` `codes`. code Character string giving clinical-code column `codes`. code_system Character string giving code-system column `codes`. Charlson Elixhauser use ICD-10 records, RxRisk uses ATC records. Punctuation letter case code-system labels ignored.

title: Identify comorbidity categories from clinical codes — identify_comorbidities
text: data frame containing person identifier followed one   binary indicator column category selected index.

title: Identify comorbidity categories from clinical codes — identify_comorbidities
text: Codes standardised using [clean_codes()], matched selected internal classification mapping, collapsed category coded either zero one per person. Charlson Elixhauser, comorbidity severity hierarchy applied, reproducing `assign0 = TRUE` comorbidity package. RxRisk categories subject hierarchy.

title: Identify comorbidity categories from clinical codes — identify_comorbidities
code: people <- data.frame(   id = c("A", "B") )  codes <- data.frame(   id = c("A", "A"),   code_system = c("ICD10", "ICD-10"),   code = c("I21.0", "I50.9") )  identify_comorbidities(   people = people,   codes = codes,   index = "charlson" ) #>   id cci_mi cci_chf cci_pvd cci_cevd cci_dementia cci_cpd cci_rheumd cci_pud #> 1  A      1       1       0        0            0       0          0       0 #> 2  B      0       0       0        0            0       0          0       0 #>   cci_mld cci_diab cci_diabwc cci_hp cci_rend cci_canc cci_msld cci_metacanc #> 1       0        0          0      0        0        0        0            0 #> 2       0        0          0      0        0        0        0            0 #>   cci_aids #> 1        0 #> 2        0
